training_source: G3 train_G1.jsonl and T_plus rows of G3 sample_schedule.jsonl, repeated 3 times
selection: minimum T_plus atomic dev target-token NLL at updates 100,200,300,400,500,600
source_padding: at least 128, dynamically extended without truncation for decoded text exceeding 128
prompt: chat template; fixed user instruction Return exactly one copy of the text below, with no introduction, ending, or extra text.
eval_split: G5 locked 53 IID plus 53 template OOD, source offset +1
distance: masked mean of encoder tokens; cosine and normalized L2 against matched gold E(y_k)
comparison: G5 frozen BART pure_latent and decode_reencode outputs
